nodes.name: Equivalent trilinear bound
nodes.statement: \left|\Lambda_m^{\pm}(f,g,h)\right|\lesssim_{\gamma,p} m\,\|f\|_p\,\|g\|_{p'}\,\|h\|_{\infty}.
nodes.label: l2cppg

nodes.name: Case 1
nodes.statement: \textbf{Case 1.} $1<p\leq 2$ $\newline$ With the notations\footnote{We will only recall here that $\phi_{j,p_0}(\eta):= \phi(\frac{\gamma'(2^{-j})\,\eta}{2^j}-p_0) $ and $\psi_{m,p_0,j}(\xi):= 2^{-\frac{m}{2}}\,e^{- i p_0 R(\frac{\xi}{2^j\,p_0})}\,\phi(\frac{\xi}{2^{m+j}})$ where $j\in\mathbb{N}$ and $p_0\in [2^m,\, 2^{m+1})\cap \mathbb{N}$ with $m\in\mathbb{N}$.} in \cite{lie2015triangle}, following the first part of the argument provided for the proof of Proposition 4.2 in Section 4 of \cite{lie2015triangle}, we have $$|\Lambda_{m}^{+}(f,g,h)|\lesssim$$ $$\int_{\mathbb{R}}\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}|(f*\check{\phi}_{m+j})(y)|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\: \left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}} \left|M\left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m} h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)(y)\right|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\,dy$$ $$\lesssim \left\| \left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p}\, \left\|\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}} \left|M\left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)\right|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}$$ $$\lesssim \|f\|_{p}\,\left\|\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\:,$$ where for the last relation we used standard Littlewood-Paley theory (for providing bounds on the square function for $f$) and Fefferman-Stein's inequality (\cite{fefferman1971some}) (for the term involving the functions $g$ and $h$). Using now that \begin{equation} ((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)=\int_{\mathbb{R}} (\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)(x-\frac{\gamma'(2^{-j})}{2^j}\,y)\,\check{\phi}(y)\,e^{i\,p_0\,y}\,dy\:, \end{equation} we deduce that \begin{equation} \sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|^2\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\,. \end{equation} Thus, applying Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we get \begin{equation} \left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)^2\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\,\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|^2\,, \end{equation} from which we deduce that \begin{equation} |\Lambda_{m}^{+}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma} \|f\|_{p}\, \|h\|_{\infty}\,\left\|\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\:. \end{equation} Finally, since $p'\geq2$, we are allowed to apply Rubio de Francia's inequality (\cite{rubio1985littlewood}): \begin{equation} \left\|\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\lesssim_{\gamma,p'} \|g\|_{p'}\:. \end{equation} Putting now together \eqref{CS}, \eqref{L}, \eqref{RF} we conclude that \eqref{l2cppg} holds.
nodes.statement_short: Case $1<p\le2$

nodes.name: Square function bound
nodes.statement: \textbf{Case 1.} $1<p\leq 2$ $\newline$ With the notations\footnote{We will only recall here that $\phi_{j,p_0}(\eta):= \phi(\frac{\gamma'(2^{-j})\,\eta}{2^j}-p_0) $ and $\psi_{m,p_0,j}(\xi):= 2^{-\frac{m}{2}}\,e^{- i p_0 R(\frac{\xi}{2^j\,p_0})}\,\phi(\frac{\xi}{2^{m+j}})$ where $j\in\mathbb{N}$ and $p_0\in [2^m,\, 2^{m+1})\cap \mathbb{N}$ with $m\in\mathbb{N}$.} in \cite{lie2015triangle}, following the first part of the argument provided for the proof of Proposition 4.2 in Section 4 of \cite{lie2015triangle}, we have $$|\Lambda_{m}^{+}(f,g,h)|\lesssim$$ $$\int_{\mathbb{R}}\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}|(f*\check{\phi}_{m+j})(y)|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\: \left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}} \left|M\left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m} h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)(y)\right|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\,dy$$ $$\lesssim \left\| \left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p}\, \left\|\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}} \left|M\left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)\right|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}$$ $$\lesssim \|f\|_{p}\,\left\|\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\:,$$ where for the last relation we used standard Littlewood-Paley theory (for providing bounds on the square function for $f$) and Fefferman-Stein's inequality (\cite{fefferman1971some}) (for the term involving the functions $g$ and $h$).
nodes.statement_short: Littlewood-Paley and Fefferman-Stein bounds

nodes.name: Control $h$
nodes.statement: Using now that \begin{equation} ((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)=\int_{\mathbb{R}} (\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)(x-\frac{\gamma'(2^{-j})}{2^j}\,y)\,\check{\phi}(y)\,e^{i\,p_0\,y}\,dy\:, \end{equation} we deduce that \begin{equation} \sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|^2\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\,. \end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: Control the $h$-pieces in $\ell^2$

nodes.name: Modulated convolution identity
nodes.statement: ((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)=\int_{\mathbb{R}} (\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)(x-\frac{\gamma'(2^{-j})}{2^j}\,y)\,\check{\phi}(y)\,e^{i\,p_0\,y}\,dy\:,

nodes.name: $\ell^2$ control of $h$-pieces
nodes.statement: \sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|^2\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\,.

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz
nodes.statement: Thus, applying Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we get \begin{equation} \left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)^2\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\,\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|^2\,, \end{equation} from which we deduce that \begin{equation} |\Lambda_{m}^{+}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma} \|f\|_{p}\, \|h\|_{\infty}\,\left\|\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\:. \end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: Cauchy-Schwarz in $p_0$

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz bound
nodes.statement: \left(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|\right)^2\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\,\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|^2\,,
nodes.label: CS

nodes.name: Bound for $\Lambda_m^+$ by a square function of $g$
nodes.statement: |\Lambda_{m}^{+}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma} \|f\|_{p}\, \|h\|_{\infty}\,\left\|\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\:.
nodes.label: L

nodes.name: Rubio de Francia
nodes.statement: Finally, since $p'\geq2$, we are allowed to apply Rubio de Francia's inequality (\cite{rubio1985littlewood}): \begin{equation} \left\|\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\lesssim_{\gamma,p'} \|g\|_{p'}\:. \end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: Apply Rubio de Francia's inequality

nodes.name: Rubio de Francia's inequality
nodes.statement: \left\|\left( \sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\lesssim_{\gamma,p'} \|g\|_{p'}\:.
nodes.statement_short: Square function over arbitrary frequency intervals is bounded on $L^{p'}$, $p'\ge2$.
nodes.label: RF

nodes.name: Conclude Case 1
nodes.statement: Putting now together \eqref{CS}, \eqref{L}, \eqref{RF} we conclude that \eqref{l2cppg} holds.
nodes.statement_short: Conclude Case 1

nodes.name: Case 2
nodes.statement: \textbf{Case 2.} $2<p<\infty$ $\newline$ In this second case, we follow part of the argument inside the proof of Proposition 4.3 in Section 4 of \cite{lie2015triangle}. Indeed, by applying Cauchy-Schwarz and then H\"older's inequality, we have \begin{equation} \end{equation} $$|\Lambda_{m}^{+}(f,g,h)|\leq$$ $$\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\int_{\mathbb{R}} h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)|^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\,dx$$ $$\leq\left\|\,\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}*\check{\psi}_{m,p_0,j})|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p} \left\|\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})|^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\:.$$ Now the content of $$\lesssim_{p} m^{\frac{2}{p'}-1}\, \|f\|_{p}\,\|h\|_{\infty}\, \left\|\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}} (g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j})^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\lesssim_{\gamma,p} nodes.name: Apply Lie's estimates
nodes.statement: Now the content of Proposition 4.4 in \cite{lie2015triangle} is the statement that for $p\geq2$ one has \begin{equation} \left\|\,\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}*\check{\psi}_{m,p_0,j}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p}\lesssim_{\gamma,p} m^{\frac{2}{p'}-1}\, \|f\|_{p}\;, \end{equation} while from the Lemma 4.9 in \cite{lie2015triangle} we deduce that \begin{equation} \sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)|^{2}\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\, M(g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j})^2(x)\:, \end{equation} where here we recall that $\phi_{\gamma,m,j}(\eta):=\phi(\frac{\gamma'(2^{-j})}{2^{j+m}}\,\eta)\;.$

nodes.name: Lie's square function estimate (Proposition 4.4)
nodes.statement: \left\|\,\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}}\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}*\check{\psi}_{m,p_0,j}|^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p}\lesssim_{\gamma,p} m^{\frac{2}{p'}-1}\, \|f\|_{p}\;,

nodes.statement: \sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)\,((\epsilon_{j,m}\, h)*\check{\phi}_{j,p_0})(x)|^{2}\lesssim_{\gamma} \|h\|_{\infty}^2\, M(g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j})^2(x)\:,

nodes.name: Conclude Case 2
nodes.statement: Inserting \eqref{Cf} and \eqref{claim} in \eqref{key2}, we conclude that \begin{equation} \end{equation} $$|\Lambda_{m}^{+}(f,g,h)|\leq_{\gamma,p} m^{\frac{2}{p'}-1}\, \|f\|_{p}\,\|h\|_{\infty}\, \left\|\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}} M(g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j})^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}$$ $$\lesssim_{p} m^{\frac{2}{p'}-1}\, \|f\|_{p}\,\|h\|_{\infty}\, \left\|\left(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{N}} (g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j})^2\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\right\|_{p'}\lesssim_{\gamma,p} m^{\frac{2}{p'}-1}\, \|f\|_{p}\,\|g\|_{p'}\,\|h\|_{\infty}\,,$$ where we made use again of the Fefferman-Stein's inequality (\cite{fefferman1971some}) (for the second inequality) and standard Littlewood-Paley theory (for the third inequality).
nodes.statement_short: Fefferman-Stein and Littlewood-Paley conclude

nodes.name: Decay bounds on the segment $(CD)$
nodes.statement: Let $1\le r<\infty$. For $m\in\mathbb{N}$, the following holds \begin{equation} \|T_{j(x),m}(f,g)(x)\|_{L^r(dx)}\lesssim_{\gamma,r}(1+m^{1-\frac{1}{r}})\,2^{-\frac{m}{20r}}\,\|f\|_{2r}\,\|g\|_{2r}. \end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: $T_{j(x),m}$ maps $L^{2r}\times L^{2r}\to L^r$ with decay $2^{-m/(20r)}$ up to polynomial loss.
nodes.label: 2r

nodes.name: Single-scale decay bounds for $T_{j,m}$
nodes.statement: Let $p, q, r$ be as in \eqref{exponents10} and \eqref{exponents20}. Then for any $j, m\in\mathbb{Z}$, we have \begin{equation} \|T_{j,m}(f,g)\|_r\lesssim_{\gamma,p,q}(1+m^{1-\frac{2}{p}})\,2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-\frac{1}{p*})}\,\|f\|_p\,\|g\|_q. \end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: Each $T_{j,m}$ is bounded $L^p\times L^q\to L^r$ with decay $2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-1/p^*)}$.
assumptions: Let $p, q, r$ be as in \eqref{exponents10} and \eqref{exponents20}.
nodes.label: Tjmb

nodes.name: Proof of the single-scale decay bounds
nodes.statement: Using the notation from (\ref{Ljm}) and \cite{lie2015triangle}, we choose $h\in L^{r'}$ such that \[ \Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)= \int_{\mathbb{R}} T_{j,m}(f,g)(x)h(x)dx. \] Therefore \[ |\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\le \int_{\mathbb{R}} |(f*\check{\phi}_{m+j})(x)\:|M\Bigg(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(\cdot) (h*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(\cdot)|\Bigg)(x)\,dx, \] and \[ |\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\le \int_{\mathbb{R}}\Bigg(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(x)(h*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(x)|^2\Bigg)^\frac{1}{2} \Bigg(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}*\check{\psi}_{m, p_0, j})(x)|^2\Bigg)^\frac{1}{2}dx. \] Hence, by following the second part of the proof of \cite[Proposition 4.2 ]{lie2015triangle} and \cite[Proposition 4.3 ]{lie2015triangle}, we deduce that the results in \cite{lie2015triangle} hold for $\Lambda_{j,m}$. In particular, the analogue of \cite[Theorem 3.3]{lie2015triangle} follows: \begin{proposition} Let $1<p<\infty$. Then the following estimates hold \begin{equation} Edge\:(AC):\:\:\:\:\:\:\:\:|\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma,p} (1+m^{1-\frac{2}{p}})2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-\frac{1}{p*})}\|f\|_p\|g\|_\infty \|h\|_{p'}, \end{equation} and \begin{equation} Edge\:(AB):\:\:\:\:\:\:\:\:|\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma,p} (1+m^{1-\frac{2}{p}})2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-\frac{1}{p*})} \|f\|_p\|g\|_{p'} \|h\|_\infty. \end{equation} \end{proposition} Thus, Proposition \ref{Tjmb} follows from the Proposition \ref{DeltaM} after applying real interpolation.
nodes.statement_short: Dualize, bound $\Lambda_{j,m}$ as in Lie 2018 to get edge estimates, then apply real interpolation.

nodes.name: Dualize
nodes.statement: Using the notation from (\ref{Ljm}) and \cite{lie2015triangle}, we choose $h\in L^{r'}$ such that \[ \Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)= \int_{\mathbb{R}} T_{j,m}(f,g)(x)h(x)dx. \]
nodes.statement_short: Choose dual function $h$

nodes.name: Bound $\Lambda_{j,m}$
nodes.statement: Therefore \[ |\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\le \int_{\mathbb{R}} |(f*\check{\phi}_{m+j})(x)\:|M\Bigg(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(\cdot) (h*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(\cdot)|\Bigg)(x)\,dx, \] and \[ |\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\le \int_{\mathbb{R}}\Bigg(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(g*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(x)(h*\check{\phi}_{j, p_0})(x)|^2\Bigg)^\frac{1}{2} \Bigg(\sum_{p_0=2^m}^{2^{m+1}}|(f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}*\check{\psi}_{m, p_0, j})(x)|^2\Bigg)^\frac{1}{2}dx. \]
nodes.statement_short: Two pointwise bounds for $\Lambda_{j,m}$

nodes.name: Edge estimates
nodes.statement: Hence, by following the second part of the proof of \cite[Proposition 4.2 ]{lie2015triangle} and \cite[Proposition 4.3 ]{lie2015triangle}, we deduce that the results in \cite{lie2015triangle} hold for $\Lambda_{j,m}$. Then the following estimates hold \begin{equation} Edge\:(AC):\:\:\:\:\:\:\:\:|\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma,p} (1+m^{1-\frac{2}{p}})2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-\frac{1}{p*})}\|f\|_p\|g\|_\infty \|h\|_{p'}, \end{equation} and \begin{equation} Edge\:(AB):\:\:\:\:\:\:\:\:|\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma,p} (1+m^{1-\frac{2}{p}})2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-\frac{1}{p*})} \|f\|_p\|g\|_{p'} \|h\|_\infty. \end{equation} \end{proposition}

nodes.statement: Hence, by following the second part of the proof of \cite[Proposition 4.2 ]{lie2015triangle} and \cite[Proposition 4.3 ]{lie2015triangle}, we deduce that the results in \cite{lie2015triangle} hold for $\Lambda_{j,m}$. In particular, the analogue of \cite[Theorem 3.3]{lie2015triangle} follows:
nodes.statement_short: Follow the second part of the proofs of Propositions 4.2 and 4.3 of Lie 2018 for $\Lambda_{j,m}$.

nodes.name: Edge estimates for $\Lambda_{j,m}$
nodes.statement: Let $1<p<\infty$. Then the following estimates hold \begin{equation} Edge\:(AC):\:\:\:\:\:\:\:\:|\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma,p} (1+m^{1-\frac{2}{p}})2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-\frac{1}{p*})}\|f\|_p\|g\|_\infty \|h\|_{p'}, \end{equation} and \begin{equation} Edge\:(AB):\:\:\:\:\:\:\:\:|\Lambda_{j,m}(f,g,h)|\lesssim_{\gamma,p} (1+m^{1-\frac{2}{p}})2^{-\frac{m}{10}(1-\frac{1}{p*})} \|f\|_p\|g\|_{p'} \|h\|_\infty. \end{equation}

nodes.name: Interpolate
nodes.statement: Thus, Proposition \ref{Tjmb} follows from the Proposition \ref{DeltaM} after applying real interpolation.

nodes.name: Proof of the $(CD)$ bound
nodes.statement_short: Use the single-scale bound with $p=q=2r$, H\"older over $j$, and Littlewood-Paley via Cauchy-Schwarz to sum the pieces.

nodes.name: Localize
nodes.statement: As we did for the proof of \eqref{l2c2}, we write \eqref{Tjm-pqr} as \begin{equation} \|T_{j,m}(f,g)\|_r\lesssim_{\gamma}(1+m^{1-\frac{1}{r}})2^{-\frac{m}{20r}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r}, \end{equation} where here we used that $p=q=2r$ and that $(2r)^*=\frac{2r}{2r-1}$ since $r\ge 1$.
nodes.statement_short: Localize the single-scale bound with $p=q=2r$

nodes.name: Localized single-scale bound
nodes.statement: \|T_{j,m}(f,g)\|_r\lesssim_{\gamma}(1+m^{1-\frac{1}{r}})2^{-\frac{m}{20r}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r},

nodes.name: Apply proposition
nodes.statement: Since \begin{equation*} |T_{j(x),m}(f,g)(x)|\le \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}|T_{j,m}(f,g)|^r\Big)^\frac{1}{r}, \end{equation*} it follows from H\"older inequality and Proposition \ref{Tjmb} that \begin{align} \big\|T_{j(x),m}(f,g)(x)\big\|_{L^r(dx)}&\le \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|T_{j,m}(f,g)\|_r^r\Big)^\frac{1}{r}\nonumber\\ &\le (1+m^{1-\frac{1}{r}})2^{-\frac{m}{20r}} \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}^r\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r}^r\Big)^\frac{1}{r}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Dominate the linearized operator and apply the proposition

nodes.name: Bound by $\ell^r$ sum over scales
nodes.statement: \big\|T_{j(x),m}(f,g)(x)\big\|_{L^r(dx)}&\le \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|T_{j,m}(f,g)\|_r^r\Big)^\frac{1}{r}\nonumber\\ &\le (1+m^{1-\frac{1}{r}})2^{-\frac{m}{20r}} \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}^r\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r}^r\Big)^\frac{1}{r}.
nodes.label: supTjm

nodes.name: Littlewood-Paley
nodes.statement: Notice that for $r\in [1,\infty)$ and for any $f, \phi\in\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R})$, we have \begin{align*} \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|f*\phi_j\|_{2r}^{2r}\Big)^\frac{1}{2r}&\le \Bigg(\int_{\mathbb{R}} \sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}|(f*\phi_j)(x)|^{2r}dx\Bigg)^\frac{1}{2r}\\ &\le \Bigg(\int_{\mathbb{R}} \Bigg(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}|(f*\phi_j)(x)|^2\Bigg)^rdx\Bigg)^\frac{1}{2r} = \Bigg(\int_{\mathbb{R}} \Bigg\{\bigg(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}|(f*\phi_j)(x)|^2\bigg)^\frac{1}{2}\Bigg\}^{2r}dx\Bigg)^\frac{1}{2r}\\ &=\Bigg\|\bigg(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}|f*\phi_j(x)|^2\bigg)^\frac{1}{2}\Bigg\|_{2r} \lesssim \|f\|_{2r}, \end{align*} here for the last relation we used standard Littlewood-Paley theory.
nodes.statement_short: $\ell^{2r}$ sum of pieces bounded by Littlewood-Paley

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz
nodes.statement: By Cauchy Schwartz, the hypothesis on $\gamma\in \mathcal{NF}$ and the result above, we obtain \begin{align} \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}^r\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r}^r\Big)^\frac{1}{r}&\le \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}^{2r}\Big)^\frac{1}{2r}\Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r}^{2r}\Big)^\frac{1}{2r} \nonumber\\ &\le_{\gamma,r} \|f\|_{2r}\|g\|_{2r}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Cauchy-Schwarz over $j$

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz and Littlewood-Paley bound
nodes.statement: \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}^r\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r}^r\Big)^\frac{1}{r}&\le \Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|f*\check{\phi}_{m+j}\|_{2r}^{2r}\Big)^\frac{1}{2r}\Big(\sum_{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\|g*\check{\phi}_{\gamma,m,j}\|_{2r}^{2r}\Big)^\frac{1}{2r} \nonumber\\ &\le_{\gamma,r} \|f\|_{2r}\|g\|_{2r}.
nodes.label: fg2r

nodes.name: Conclude
nodes.statement: Inserting \eqref{fg2r} in \eqref{supTjm} we get \begin{equation} \big\|T_{j(x),m}(f,g)(x)\big\|_{L^r(dx)}\le_{\gamma,r} (1+m^{1-\frac{1}{r}})2^{-\frac{m}{20r}}\|f\|_{2r}\|g\|_{2r}, \end{equation} as desired.
nodes.statement_short: Combine

nodes.name: Alternative route via the edge $(CD)$
nodes.statement: In order to prove our main Theorem \ref{high_frequency_diagonal theorem} in the interior of $\triangle ABC$ it is in fact not necessary to pursue the boundedness of our operator along the edge $(CD)$. Indeed, one could apply interpolation between the bounds corresponding to the edges $(AB)$ and $(AC)$ instead, with the latter discussed in the next section. However, we wanted to offer a less expected but more interesting alternative approach to the trivial bounds one gets along the segment $(AC)$. This is especially useful in situations in which one deals with similar type operators but for which one does not have a good control on the edges $(BC)$ and $(AC)$.
nodes.statement_short: The $(CD)$ bounds are not needed for the interior (interpolate $(AB)$ and $(AC)$), but give an alternative approach.

nodes.name: Proof of the edge $(AC]$ bound
nodes.statement: From the definition \eqref{definition} of $M_\Gamma$ it is trivial to notice that for all $x\in\mathbb{R}$, \begin{align} |M_\Gamma(f,g)(x)|&\le \|g\|_\infty\, \sup_{\varepsilon>0}\frac{1}{2\varepsilon}\int_{-\varepsilon}^\varepsilon |f(x-t)|dt\nonumber\\ &\le \|g\|_\infty\, Mf(x). \end{align} Hence, applying the classical results on the Hardy-Littlewood maximal operator we get
nodes.section: 5.1 Bounds on the edge $(AC]$: $1< p\le \infty$, $r=p$ and $q=\infty$
nodes.statement_short: Bound $M_\Gamma(f,g)\le\|g\|_\infty Mf$ and use the Hardy-Littlewood maximal theorem.

nodes.name: $M_\Gamma(f,g)\le\|g\|_\infty Mf$
nodes.statement: |M_\Gamma(f,g)(x)|&\le \|g\|_\infty\, \sup_{\varepsilon>0}\frac{1}{2\varepsilon}\int_{-\varepsilon}^\varepsilon |f(x-t)|dt\nonumber\\ &\le \|g\|_\infty\, Mf(x).

nodes.name: Reduction of the $(BC]$ bound to the maximal function along $\gamma$
nodes.statement: From \eqref{discretizationc}, recalling that $\gamma\in\mathcal{NF}$ and our choice of $j_0$ in \eqref{threshold} - \eqref{threshold1}, we notice that for all $x\in\mathbb{R}$, \begin{align} |M_\Gamma(f,g)(x)|&\le \|f\|_\infty\,M_\gamma\, g(x) . \end{align} where here \begin{equation} M_\gamma\, g(x):=\sup\limits_{{j\in\mathbb{Z}}\atop{|j|>j_0}}\frac{1}{2^{j+1}}\int\limits_{2^j\le|t|\le2^{j+1}} |g(x+\gamma(t))|dt\,. \end{equation} Thus, Theorem \ref{finfty} follows from the result below

nodes.statement: For any $1<q\le \infty$, one has \begin{equation} \|M_\gamma(g)\|_{L^q}\lesssim_{\gamma,q} \|g\|_q. \end{equation}

nodes.name: $L^q$ bound for $M_\gamma$
nodes.statement: \|M_\gamma(g)\|_{L^q}\lesssim_{\gamma,q} \|g\|_q.
nodes.section: 5.2 Bounds on the edge $(BC]$: $1< q\le \infty$, $r=q$ and $p=\infty$

nodes.name: Proof of the bound for $M_\gamma$
nodes.statement: From the properties of $\gamma$ and the choice of $j_0$ in \eqref{threshold} - \eqref{threshold1}, it is straightforward to check that for any $k\in \mathbb{Z}$ with $|k|>j_0$ and $t\in[2^k,2^{k+1}]$ one has \begin{equation} |\gamma(2^{k})|\approx_{\gamma} 2^{k}|\gamma'(t)|\approx_{\gamma}|\gamma(2^{k+1})|\,. \end{equation} From \eqref{threshold1}, we deduce that $\gamma$ is strictly monotone and invertible over each of the intervals $(-\infty,-2^{j_0})$, $(-2^{-j_0},0)$, $(0,2^{-j_0})$ and $(2^{j_0}, \infty)$.
